title: Upgrading from Free to Pro
content: Upgrade from Settings > Billing. Pro access is activated automatically once the payment is captured, usually within 1 minute. If the plan still shows Free after a successful charge, the upgrade is stuck in provisioning and must be fixed by the Billing team.

title: Pending charges and duplicate payment attempts
content: Each upgrade attempt creates a card authorization that appears as a pending charge. Failed or duplicate authorizations are normally released by the bank within 3-5 business days. Only the Billing team can void authorizations or issue refunds; agents must not promise refund timelines.

title: Refunds and chargeback policy
content: Refunds are issued by the Billing team. If a customer threatens a bank dispute, escalate to Billing immediately so the duplicate charges can be voided before the dispute is filed.

title: Pro export features
content: Pro plans include high-resolution PDF and PPTX export. Billing can grant a temporary 24-hour Pro trial while a payment issue is investigated.

title: Troubleshooting HTTP 500 errors
content: A single user seeing HTTP 500 can try clearing cache or another browser. If multiple users, devices and browsers are affected, treat it as a service-side incident and escalate to Incident Response with the customer's data region.

title: Status page and regional incidents
content: status.company.com shows global status and may lag behind regional incidents. Always check internal regional monitoring before telling a customer that systems are operational.

title: Appearance settings and dark mode
content: Settings > Appearance offers Light, Dark and System Default themes on web and desktop. Dark mode is available on all paid plans.

title: Known issue: desktop app ignores macOS dark mode (v3.2.x)
content: In macOS desktop app v3.2.x the Dark option is missing from Settings > Appearance and System Default does not follow the macOS appearance. Workaround: use the web app, which supports dark mode. Fix planned for v3.3. Engineering ticket ENG-2187.

title: Submitting feature requests
content: Feature requests are logged by the Product team. Thank the customer, confirm the request was recorded, and do not promise delivery dates. Scheduled theme switching is not currently supported.
